hashPolicy.capturedRaw: files[].sha256 and bytes preserve the exact original G6 working-tree bytes at the recorded clean HEAD; never rewritten.
hashPolicy.canonical: Valid round-trippable UTF-8 text without NUL normalizes CRLF to LF; binary data remains byte-exact. canonical.sha256 is the portable verification identity.
hashPolicy.candidate: Adaptations/additions preserve their captured candidate raw hashes separately from canonical content hashes.
